//: Standalone typecheck for @insimul/babylon (npm run typecheck). Mirrors the root tsconfig.check.json compiler options so the package type-checks identically in isolation and as part of the whole-repo check. Unlike @insimul/core, this package OWNS the web/Babylon layer, so `lib` includes 'dom' (the conversation SDK touches MediaStream/WebGPU/window). Data/engine layers arrive in US-BC2/US-BC3.
